cousin simple.name: Cousin Simple
cousin simple.note: The example recordings match the Columbus, Ohio band. Indie rock and alternative rock describe its core sound, with indie pop reflecting the melodic hooks heard across its releases.

half•alive.name: half•alive
half•alive.note: The Spotify ID and all three recordings match the Long Beach band. Indie pop and alternative rock best describe the catalog, with synth-heavy production and dance grooves supporting the other tags. Funk and soul are influences.

huntr/x.name: HUNTR/X
huntr/x.note: HUNTR/X is the fictional girl group from KPop Demon Hunters, voiced by EJAE, Audrey Nuna, and Rei Ami. Its recordings center on dance-oriented K-pop written for the film, with pop rap most prominent on the harder-edged tracks.

linus from the stars.name: Linus from the Stars
linus from the stars.note: Melodic, synth-led songwriting makes synthpop the clearest fit across the releases. Indie pop is a broader secondary fit, and finer genre distinctions are less consistently documented.

miki fiki.name: Miki Fiki
miki fiki.note: Ted Hartog’s Nashville project centers on indie pop, with bedroom-pop production, funk grooves, and neo-soul arrangements. Indie pop is the clearest catalog-wide label, while the other styles vary by release.

owl city.name: Owl City
owl city.note: Synthpop and electropop define Adam Young’s Owl City catalog, with indietronica most evident in the early recordings and dance-pop more prominent in later singles.

twenty one pilots.name: Twenty One Pilots
twenty one pilots.note: Alternative rock is the through line, with rapped verses and synth-driven pop recurring across the catalog. The last two labels capture the band’s melodic and emo-influenced songwriting, which varies by album.
